name: arithmoslayer-mobile
description: Capacitor shell for the Arithmo Slayer Android and iOS apps. Wraps the web game in sites/ffm/static as bundled, offline-first assets. The website deploys separately from sites/ffm/static and is unaffected by this project.

scripts.build:debug: npm run copy-assets && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.install:debug: npm run copy-assets && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run copy-assets && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
